meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你把对 NanoClaw 项目的自定义修改提取成一份迁移指南，然后用这份指南在干净的上游代码上重新应用你的修改，避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你需要将 NanoClaw 分支的自定义修改升级到上游新版本时触发。

say.text: 帮我提取当前分支的自定义修改，生成迁移指南。
say.note: Claude 会分析你的修改并生成指南。

say.text: 用已有的迁移指南升级到上游最新版。
say.note: Claude 会跳过提取阶段，直接应用指南。

howto.what_en: Extracts user customizations from a NanoClaw fork into a migration guide, then upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base, avoiding merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to upgrade a customized NanoClaw fork to a new upstream version.

say_en.text: Extract my customizations and generate a migration guide.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze your changes and create the guide.

say_en.text: Upgrade using the existing migration guide.
say_en.note: Claude will skip extraction and apply the guide directly.
